segments.text: What was wrong with the man's story?
segments.translation: 这个人的说法有什么问题？

segments.text: 'At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train to London,' said the man.
segments.translation: '谋杀发生时，我正乘8点钟的火车去伦敦，'那人说。

segments.text: 'Do you always catch such an early train?' asked the inspector.
segments.translation: '你总是赶这么早的火车吗？'探长问。

segments.text: 'Of course I do,' answered the man.
'I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
My employer will confirm that I was there on time.'
segments.translation: 我的雇主会证实我准时到达。'

segments.text: 'Would a later train get you to work on time?' asked the inspector.
segments.translation: '晚一点的火车能让你准时上班吗？'探长问。

segments.text: 'I suppose it would, but I never catch a later train.'
segments.translation: '我想可以，但我从不乘晚一点的火车。'

segments.text: 'At what time did you arrive at the station?'
'At ten to eight. I bought a paper and waited for the train.'
segments.translation: '7点50分。我买了一份报纸，等着火车。'
'你没有注意到什么不寻常的事情吗？'

segments.text: 'I suggest,' said the inspector,' that you are not telling the truth.
segments.translation: '我认为，'探长说，'你没有说实话。

segments.text: I suggest that you did not catch the 8 o'clock train,
segments.translation: 我认为你没有赶上8点钟的火车，

segments.text: but that you caught the 8.25 which would still get you to work on time.
segments.translation: 而是赶上了8点25分的火车，这仍然可以让你准时上班。

segments.text: You see, on the morning of the murder, the 8 o'clock train did not run at all.
segments.translation: 你看，在案发那天早上，8点钟的火车根本没有开。

segments.text: It broke down at Ferngreen station and was taken off the line.'
segments.translation: 它在芬格林站坏了，被撤出了运行。'
